THE CORE IDEA

runs.text: Market equilibrium occurs where quantity demanded equals quantity supplied. At that price, buyers can purchase the amount they want and sellers can sell the amount they offer, so there is no pressure for price to change. A demand or supply shift creates a new intersection and can change both equilibrium price and equilibrium quantity.

WORKED EXAMPLE: FINDING MARKET EQUILIBRIUM

runs.text: The horizontal axis is quantity of gas in thousands and the vertical axis is price of gas. Original demand D0 and original supply S0 intersect at price $3 and quantity 150 thousand. Demand shifts right to D1 while supply shifts left to S1. D1 and S1 intersect at price $5 and quantity 150 thousand. Holding S0 fixed, D1 intersects S0 at price $4 and quantity 200 thousand. Holding D0 fixed, S1 intersects D0 at price $4 and quantity 100 thousand.
